units: <cite ref="Sanhedrin 26b:12">Snh. 26ᵇ</cite> <he>ה׳ בב״ד</he> announcement in court proclaiming a person disqualified as a witness.
<cite ref="Sanhedrin 89a:6">Ib. 89ᵃ</cite> <he>צריכין ה׳</he> must be published, as to the nature of the crime for which they are to be executed.
<cite ref="Devarim Rabbah 11:11">Deut. R. s. 11</cite> <he>ממונה על הה׳</he> appointed to announce the divine decrees.
